comment: The provision-admin and probe argv the IDE builds with serviceConfig set (BACKLOG #5566). probeDefault is the probe with messagefoundry.serviceConfig at its default. ide/src/test/suite/provision-admin-argv.test.ts pins the IDE builders against these lists. tests/test_ide_provision_admin_argv.py reads them with the engine parser. tests/test_ide_start_plan_probe_contract.py runs probeDefault against a real store.
